name: interpolate

test_list.description: Linear interpolation returns the y value at every knot.
Catmull-Rom returns all exact knots and interpolates within supported range.
Knots must be strictly ordered by x.
Out-of-domain queries return a typed error.
NaN and infinities cannot enter through constructors or serde.
Bezier interpolation remains inside the convex hull for t in [0,1].
Bilinear interpolation exactly reproduces each validated grid corner within float tolerance.

inputs.name: knots
inputs.description: Strictly increasing finite x/y control points.

output_description: A finite interpolated y value or typed validation/range error.
